text: The version byte at offset 4 of a `.saidx` file exists so a newer `libsail` can still read an index written by an older one (Jack: 'the version byte is how we know to read the old index formats'). A layout change bumps `VERSION` and gains a reader arm for the old layout. It does not invalidate index files on disk. The source misleads: `read_from` and `read_head` reject any other version and the comment above `VERSION` calls that the policy. That is what the code does today, not what the byte is for.
